notes.title: Version 1.8.0
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Player City version 1.8.0[/b][/h1]
Incremental size: 798.9 MB

[h2][b]Added "Farroupilha Antigamente" Scene[/b][/h2]
[list][*] New Achievement, "Snow in the 50s".
[*] New Achievement, "Caravaggio in the 50's".
[*] New Conquest, "Farroupilha, tourist town, 1950."[/list]
[h2][b]**Parque dos Pinheiros**[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Re-lighting all photos and videos in the Park, making the display of the content in its original form, removing the layer which makes it look opaque, bringing more clarity to the content.
[*] Bake reprocessed, making the game even more fluent in its gameplay.
[*] Fixed raycast issue where the camera would go under ground.
[*] Changed grass color to a darker tone.
[*] Camera 05 moved to add new photos.
[*] 4 New photos to the south near the stairs.
[*] 5 New photos to the south near the kiosk.
[*] Added sharpness, contrast, and saturation to scenes.[/list]
[h2][b]**Praça da Matriz**[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Updated aerial video which was having difficulty playing on some computers, now being able to play on low performance machines without crashes.
[*] Photos and videos of the interior of the Church with reprocessed lighting.
[*] Photos and videos of the outside of the square with reprocessed lighting.
[*] Added sharpness, contrast, and saturation to scenes.[/list]
[h2][b]**Salto Ventoso**[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Re-illuminates all videos in the location.
[*] Fixed raycast issue where the camera would go under ground.
[*] Added sharpness, contrast, and saturation to scenes.
[*] Changed lookout scene UI to buttons[/list]
